i18n.name: 本地应用安装
i18n.description: 网页端上传 .tpk 安装包的入口：把本地安装包注册进应用中心并自动安装/升级。支持拖拽上传、本地包库管理（重装 / 下载 / 删除）与环境自检。
i18n.author: 西了个瓜
i18n.versionContent: 1. 修正图标说明：手机 App 不渲染 data: 图标，桌面/局域网/中转正常。\n2. 手机端显示正解：TPK_PUBLIC_BASE 配本机 HTTPS 前缀，重启自动切换，已装应用无需重装。

i18n.name: Local App Installer
i18n.description: Upload local .tpk packages, register them into the app center and install/upgrade automatically. Includes drag-and-drop upload, a local package library (reinstall / download / delete) and an environment self-check.
i18n.author: 西了个瓜
i18n.versionContent: 1. Corrected icon docs: phone clients do not render data: icons; desktop/LAN/relay are fine.\n2. Phone fix: set TPK_PUBLIC_BASE to the HTTPS prefix of this machine; URLs heal on restart, no reinstall needed.

i18ns.name: 访问口令（留空则首次打开页面时设置）
i18ns.description: 打开安装器页面时需要输入的口令。安装包里的脚本以 root 在 NAS 上执行，所以这个页面不能没有口令。留空则由第一个打开页面的人自行设置（不需要 root 权限）。

i18ns.name: Access password (set on first page open if empty)
i18ns.description: Password required to open the installer page. Scripts inside installed packages run as root on the NAS, so this page must be protected. Left empty, the first visitor sets it on the page (no root needed).
